breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2 with K = 0.7 directly entering the effective length calculation (K L = 0.7 × 2000 = 1400 mm). It does not include the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt that treated K as affecting only the mode shape while evaluating the Euler load from π^2 E I / L^2. The formula and computation fully align with the ground truth.
